newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello says Moody's reflects budget position.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello says Moody's reflects budget position.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday that an improved outlook from Moody's for the country's sovereign debt rating represented international recognition of Australia's improved budget position.

Costello told a news conference that the recognition would lead to a benign interest rate climate. Moody's Investors Services said earlier that Australia's rating outlook was improving because of a steady fiscal policy framework and prudent monetary policy stance.
In a commentary from New York, the agency noted that economic growth and fiscal tightening measures in the past few years had had a positive influence on the underlying budget deficit.
The agency said, however, hoever, that any change in Australia's Aa2 long-term rating would depend on the nation further reducing its reliance on foreign savings.
